label: nyiso 8 seasonal-ce-ttc
definition: U7 on top of U4: replaces the estimated annual Central-East limit (2350/3850) with the MEASURED monthly DAM TTC for the CENT EAST interface from NYISO ATC/TTC postings (~1750 MW 2023, stepping to ~2850 from Dec-2023 with the AC Transmission upgrade), applied per-hour via a seasonal envelope. Proves the interface limit, not gas basis, drives the west-east spread: 2024 MAE 7.2->2.3 and 2025 7.8->3.2 vs the no-U4/U7 baseline as the spread opens correctly (2024 +0.2->+7.1 vs actual +3.7; 2025 +0.2->+14.5 vs +7.9). But the faithful tight 2023 limit over-binds: it bottles the upstate cheap surplus and collapses Upstate to ~$6 (actual $25.3), spread +37.8 vs +9.3. Per rule #12 the measured limit STAYS; the 2023 residual localizes the next root cause = the upstate cheap-energy balance (too much trapped surplus), not the TTC.
